title: NewsBench: Expert-Grounded Evaluation of Epistemic Quality in AI News Reporting
abstract: arXiv:2610.33240v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As frontier AI systems increasingly serve as sources of political and current-events information, evaluating the epistemic quality of their responses is now especially consequential. Existing evaluations often focus narrowly on ideological alignment, rely on measures not validated for this setting, or depend on reference labels derived from public opinion or non-expert annotation, potentially producing misleading or miscalibrated results. To address these limitations, we introduce NewsBench, an expert-grounded benchmark that reframes evaluation around editorial standards developed by senior practitioners in journalism, policy, and intelligence analysis. NewsBench operationalizes quality across three dimensions, source quality, factuality, and neutrality, using a two-phase pipeline in which domain experts first define and calibrate evaluation guidelines, which are then transferred to automated AI judges validated against expert-adjudicate

translated_title: NewsBench：基于专家的AI新闻报道认知质量评估
translated_abstract: 随着前沿AI系统日益成为政治和时事信息的重要来源，评估其回答的认知质量变得尤为关键。现有评估往往狭隘地聚焦于意识形态一致性，依赖未经此场景验证的测量方法，或依赖源自公众舆论或非专家标注的参考标签，可能产生误导性或校准不当的结果。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了NewsBench，一个以专家为基础的基准，它围绕新闻、政策和情报分析领域资深从业者制定的编辑标准重新构建评估框架。NewsBench在来源质量、事实性和中立性三个维度上对质量进行操作化定义，采用两阶段流程：领域专家首先定义并校准评估指南，随后将这些指南转移给经过专家裁定数据验证的自动化AI评判者。
tldr: 该论文提出了NewsBench，一个基于新闻、政策和情报分析领域资深专家编辑标准的AI新闻报道认知质量评估基准，从来源质量、事实性和中立性三个维度，通过“专家定义指南、AI评判者执行评估”的两阶段流程弥补了现有评估依赖非专家标注的缺陷。
en_tdlr: NewsBench is an expert-grounded benchmark that evaluates the epistemic quality of AI news reporting across source quality, factuality, and neutrality, using editorial standards from senior journalism, policy, and intelligence practitioners through a two-phase pipeline that transfers expert-calibrated guidelines to validated automated AI judges.
